_comment: Copy to consumables.json to change what counts as prepared. flask/food/vantus/rune are matched against the buffs active on each player when the pull starts (WCL combatant info). combat_potion/healing_potion/mana_potion/healthstone are matched against CAST names (item uses during the pull; a combat potion cast in the 5 s before the pull is the pre-pot). Lower-case substrings; a pattern starting with '-' excludes names containing it.
